test_unicode_conversion: test pybind11 unicode string casting between Python and C++ for utf8, utf16, utf32, and wchar types
test_single_char_arguments: test pybind11 single character argument casting for char, char16, char32, and wchar types with error handling
test_string_view: test pybind11 C++17 string_view argument and return value casting for utf8, utf16, and utf32 views
test_integer_casting: test pybind11 integer type casting including out-of-range rejection for i32, u32, i64, and u64 types
test_tuple: test pybind11 std::pair and std::tuple casting to and from Python tuples with lvalue and rvalue support
